annotation.justification: The clause provides clear guidance on the use of stream IDs for pushed resources. It allows for out-of-order initiation of streams for pushed resources but mandates sequential allocation of stream IDs for promised resources. This does not permit materially different interpretations that would affect implementation behavior.
